h:
Chroma 风格和速度工作流程是一个高效的 ComfyUI 设置，专为那些想要风格多样性、速度和零节点搜索废话。它使用一个干净的提示选择器系统，让您可以在61 种不同的视觉风格只需单击一下数字，再加上当您想要手动操作时的后备“无样式”默认值。

这不是 LoRA 选择器。工作流程包括五个预烘焙 LoRA已根据经过测试的优势进行调整，以实现最佳的美学平衡。全部都来自于优秀的Chroma LoRA 实验集合，并因其融合细节、速度和氛围的能力而被选中：

  • Hyper-Chroma-低步-LoRA：强度1

  • 色度解锁-v35-详细校准：0.75

  • Chroma-Turbo: 1

  • Hyper-Chroma-8steps-最小: 1

  • Chroma_NSFW_Porn_lora：0.13（纯粹用于解剖现实主义——根据口味进行调整）

完整图像运行在8步, 平均在 3090 上，768x1024 下约 13 秒，VRAM 占用空间约为18GB。风格选择通过简单的索引切换来处理，视觉效果令人惊叹——无论您的目标是电影现实主义、浮世绘、矢量风格化、复古纸浆，还是看起来像从木栅海报中走出来的东西。

该设置经过了战斗测试和打磨，可快速进行创造性探索。并不是说它客观上是最好的——但它确实是为了大力打击、快速渲染并保持灵活性.

o.en:
Chroma Style and Speed Workflowis a high-efficiency ComfyUI setup built for those who wantstyle variety, speed, and zero node-hunting bullshit. It uses a clean prompt selector system that lets you swap between61 distinct visual styleswith a single number click—plus a fallback “no-style” default when you want to go manual.

This isn’t a LoRA selector. The workflow includesfive pre-baked LoRAsalready tuned in with tested strengths for optimal aesthetic balance. They’re all sourced from the excellentChroma LoRA Experiments collection, and were chosen for their ability to blend detail, speed, and vibe:

  • Hyper-Chroma-low-step-LoRA: strength 1

  • Chroma-unlocked-v35-detail-calibrated: 0.75

  • Chroma-Turbo: 1

  • Hyper-Chroma-8steps-minimal: 1

  • Chroma_NSFW_Porn_lora: 0.13 (used purely for anatomical realism—adjust to taste)

The full image runs in8 steps, averaging~13 seconds at 768x1024 on a 3090, with a VRAM footprint around18GB. Style selection is handled by simple index toggles, and visual results are striking—whether you're aiming for cinematic realism, Ukiyo-e, vector stylization, retro pulp, or something that looks like it walked out of a Mucha poster.

This setup’s been battle-tested and polished for creative exploration at speed. Not claiming it’s objectively the best—but it’s dialed in tohit hard, render fast, and stay flexible.
